All 4 quarter variants (Q1-Q4) of the DATEV endpoint return 200. Quarter period string embedded in EXTF meta header.

Frontend BIC input in ProSettingsPage shows red border-red-400 class + inline error 'BIC must be exactly 8 or 11 characters (e.g. BKAUATWW or BKAUATWWXXX)' on invalid-length input. Error disappears on valid 8/11-char BIC.
Dashboard DATEV shortcut button (tax-dashboard-datev-btn) links to correct API URL with current year.
Reports tab DATEV card (datev-export-card) has all 5 quarter selector buttons + 3 download buttons.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids found + BIC validation UI verified)

rca_of_the_issue.bic_qr_fix: Previously build_epc_qr_png() passed any BIC string directly to segno helpers.make_epc_qr(), which requires exactly 8 or 11 chars and raises on other lengths (e.g. 9-char BTSABAXXX). Fix: check len(bic_clean) not in (8, 11) before calling segno — drop invalid BIC to None so QR is generated without BIC field. Verified: PNG bytes returned, valid magic bytes b'\x89PNG'.
rca_of_the_issue.bic_api_validation: PATCH /api/profile/pro now checks BIC length before writing to DB. Returns 400 HTTPException with detail message mentioning 8 or 11 chars and example values.
rca_of_the_issue.datev_export: New GET /api/tax/exports/datev-full.csv endpoint calls datev_buchungsstapel() which writes EXTF 700 meta header + German column headers + Einnahmen rows (Konto 4000, S/H=H) + Ausgaben rows (Konto 6815/6920, S/H=S). Returns UTF-8 BOM encoded CSV. All quarters + full-year work correctly.
